mcqs.question: Who became the first Indian writer to receive the Lifetime Libertarian Award of Liberty International at its 40th World Conference in Kathmandu on 8 August 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Gurucharan Das became the first Indian writer to receive the Lifetime Libertarian Award of the US-based Liberty International. The award was presented at the organisation’s 40th World Conference in Kathmandu on 8 August 2026. India Unbound is one of his works, not the award recipient.
